compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
88 test modules have a `<name>_heldout.py` twin (17,549 held-out LOC) and **76** more held-out modules have no base twin (13,930 LOC) — 164 held-out modules in all. CORRECTED: this epic previously said 88 unpaired at 17,106 LOC; 88 is the *paired* count and the two were transposed. Cross-check: S1-S4 merge 39 + 22 + 10 + 17 = exactly 88 pairs, and S5 renames the 76 remainder. The held-out convention exists so a reviewer can see a fresh oracle beside the original, but once both are merged the split only doubles module count, duplicates 89 identical helper definitions, and makes every rename touch two files. Across the 88 pairs only one test-function name collides and **44** helper definitions differ (re-measured by parsing both modules of every pair and comparing same-name top-level definitions; measured per stratum, so each story inherits an exact target rather than a share of a total):

| Story stratum | pairs | identical defs | differing defs | of which pytest fixtures |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S1 `tests/unit/` root | 39 | 34 | 13 | 4 |
| S2 `tests/unit/` subpackages | 22 | 25 | 14 | 1 |
| S3 `tests/interfaces/` + `tests/integration/` | 17 | 16 | 6 | 0 |
| S4 `tests/scripts/` | 10 | 14 | 11 | 3 |
| **total** | **88** | **89** | **44** | **8** |

**Fixture-rename hazard — applies to S1, S2 and S4.** 8 of the 44 differing definitions are pytest fixtures
(`store`, `clean_registry` and siblings). A fixture's callers do not reference it with a call expression; they bind
it by **test-function parameter name**. So suffixing a differing fixture `_heldout` and repointing only call sites
leaves the held-out tests' signatures naming the old fixture, which collects as an error or silently binds the base
fixture instead. Every story that renames a fixture must rename the parameter in each held-out test signature that
requests it, and must show the per-file node count unchanged (criterion 2) as the check that nothing was
mis-bound. The bulk of each held-out module is its **821** definitions that have no same-name base counterpart, which append unchanged, so the merge is mechanical: append the held-out module under a divider, dedupe identical definitions, suffix differing ones `_heldout`, delete the twin. Three unpaired held-out files are cross-tier twins whose basename would collide under pytest's prepend import mode and take a disambiguating suffix instead. The code epics of this breaking release edit many of these twin modules, so this epic starts only after every code epic that edits `tests/` is closed; its blocking links record that. The full pair list with per-pair rename sets and the **76** unpaired renames are in the test-suite epic's first comment. All counts in this epic were re-measured on origin/main ce5795c6a5c.

Ratchet note: the one autouse fixture inside a pair (`tests/unit/reconciler/state/test_backend_scalar_surface{,_heldout}.py::_clean`, identical bodies) keeps the base key and buckets the held-out key as `stale`, so `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` **exits 0** and `--update-stale` is not run.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] No `tests/**/test_*_heldout.py` file remains, and this epic introduces **no new duplicate test-module basename**: `git ls-files 'tests/*.py' | grep -v '__init__.py$' | grep -v 'conftest.py$' | xargs -n1 basename | sort | uniq -d` yields exactly `test_cli.py`, `test_link_sync.py`, `test_snapshot.py` — the same 3 as before this epic. Checked by the rename story. AMENDED: this criterion previously required the unqualified `git ls-files tests | xargs -n1 basename | sort | uniq -d` to be empty, which no correct implementation could satisfy — on a clean tree it already prints 10 lines (`__init__.py`, `conftest.py`, `README.md`, `pyproject.toml`, 3 JSON fixtures, and the 3 pre-existing test-module collisions above), all either intentional infrastructure or pre-dating this epic. The before/after comparison is what this work controls.
- [x] For every merged pair the base module collects **every node from both prior modules, with identical definitions deduplicated** — its count equals the sum of the two prior counts minus the definitions dropped as byte-identical duplicates, and each story records that drop count beside its before/after table. Every unpaired rename keeps its node count unchanged. AMENDED: the criterion previously demanded *exactly* the sum, contradicting criterion 3's own requirement that identical definitions be deduplicated — a correct merge that drops a duplicate necessarily lands below the sum, so both could not hold. This surfaced as the blocking finding on story `361f-0a5c-4e2c-4d6b`, whose Approach deletes a whole duplicate twin. Checked per story from before/after `pytest --collect-only -q` runs recorded on the ticket.
- [x] Identical definitions are deduplicated and differing ones carry the `_heldout` suffix with their callers repointed; no test body changes. Checked by review of each merge diff.
- [x] `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` **exits 0** and `make verify` exits 0 after each story. AMENDED from `new=0`: `new=N` counts marker-admitted entries, so an already-clean tree reports a nonzero `new` and still exits 0 — the exit code is the pass signal. Root cause: bug `6f24-3d47-b251-4905`, fixed in `AGENTS.md` and `rebar explain plan`.

## Child decomposition
- S1 merge the 39 `tests/unit/` root pairs: criteria 2 and 3 for that directory; depends on the test-suite epic's last story and every code epic.
- S2 merge the 22 pairs under `tests/unit/{metrics,workflow,reconciler}`: criteria 2 and 3; depends on S1.
- S3 merge the 17 pairs under `tests/interfaces/` and `tests/integration/`: criteria 2 and 3; depends on S1.
- S4 merge the 10 pairs under `tests/scripts/`: criteria 2 and 3; depends on S1.
- S5 rename the **76** unpaired held-out modules: criterion 1; depends on S2, S3, S4.
